title: docs(releases): curate the 17.4.0 release notes
body:
Fixes #17350

Replaces the machine draft on `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx` with curated
release notes in the shape of `17-3.mdx`, and retires the "machine draft"
notices on the v17 index. Docs only — nothing here publishes, so there is no
changeset.

## What changed

`content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx` (449 → 729 lines)

- **Frontmatter** — the draft marker is gone from `description`.
- **Highlights** — was "Not written, and deliberately not guessed"; now eleven
  bold-lead items written from the breaking list, in the 17.3.0 register (one
  lead, the commit or issue in parentheses, the migration one-liner where one
  exists).
- **Breaking changes & migration in 17.4.0** — was 35 raw changeset headlines
  with a package-name span under each. Now eleven themed `####` subsections,
  each with a **Migration** note: duration keys carrying their unit; the
  read-only strip on non-system INSERT; `positions[]` as the security axis;
  `driver-turso`'s `timeout`; the analytics date-range vocabulary; the flow
  id-space and expression-slot refusals; the record-change flow record; the
  client SDK's declared response contracts; author-time refusals; runtime and
  driver behaviour; and a `#### Smaller breaking changes in 17.4.0` list for the
  rest. The heading text is unchanged, so `#breaking-changes--migration-in-1740`
  still resolves.
- **New capabilities in 17.4.0** — was 140 verbatim bullets in package order.
  Now themed prose paragraphs (authoring gates, automation and approvals,
  analytics, tenancy and identity, sharing, errors and refusals, packages and
  metadata, CLI and scaffolding, runtime surface), with ledger registrations,
  `dist` census rows and test-only pins folded away. One paragraph names
  `action.ai.requiresConfirmation` explicitly as a declaration that no door
  enforces yet, so nobody reads it as a gate.
- **Notable fixes in 17.4.0** replaces the per-package count table. Six grouped
  passages chosen for what an upgrading deployment notices: tenancy walls that
  were not holding, audit stamps that were caller-supplied, failures that used
  to pass silently, installs and boots that failed outright, wire and query
  shapes, and flow/template arithmetic. One sentence sends the rest to the
  per-package changelogs.
- **New in Console (Studio) — objectui pins in 17.4.0** — the "the intermediate
  bumps are not enumerated here" admission is gone. Both pin moves are named
  (`236f2df`, `30b0990`) and all six declared-breaking upstream entries are
  written up for console hosts and authors, from `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md`
  under `## 17.4.0`. objectui's git history was not walked; the shallow sibling
  checkout does not carry those SHAs and the console changelog already records
  every declared entry.
- **Upgrade checklist → 17.4.0** — was "Not written". Now derived from the
  breaking list in the 17.3.0 grouping (Getting onto the release / Metadata and
  build / Data and database / Deployment and configuration / Application code,
  hooks and flows). ⛔ **Nobody has walked 17.3.0 → 17.4.0**, the section says so
  in its opening sentence, and every single line carries **not exercised**. The
  word "measured" appears nowhere as a claim about this hop. The pin-move step
  still links `/docs/upgrading#moving-the-dependency-pins`, and the
  `## Upgrade checklist` heading is unchanged so `#upgrade-checklist` still
  resolves.

`content/docs/releases/v17/index.mdx` (199 → 204 lines)

- The status blockquote's "17.4.0's notes are a machine draft, not curated"
  paragraph is replaced by one sentence in the register of the 17.3.0 sentence
  above it, linking both anchors on the 17.4.0 page.
- The **Upgrade checklists** callout now states that the 17.4.0 list, like the
  17.2.0 one, is derived from each change's own Migration note and is marked
  not exercised.

`content/docs/releases/index.mdx` is **not** touched: its v17 entry reads
"current series: 17.4.0, released 2026-09-09" and never calls 17.4.0 a draft,
which is the condition the card set for editing it.

## Constraints held

- **Counts are not the content.** No count table, no per-package tally, no "N+"
  claim. The one scale sentence names the date and the predecessor and no
  number of changesets at all — tighter than the ceiling the card allowed, per
  the maintainer's tone guidance on the README rewrites (「数量 相关的统计都去掉」,
  「价值不大的段落都可以删除」).
- **The ADR-0090 D3 reserved word appears zero times** in both edited files.
  `node scripts/check-role-word.mjs` exits 0; the baseline carries no entry for
  either file, so any occurrence would have been a new-use failure. Where the
  `positions[]` entry needs to name the third-party scalar it was split from,
  the page describes it rather than spelling it.
- **Every hash and issue number is quoted from the changelog entry itself.** The
  worklist was built by walking every `packages/**/CHANGELOG.md`, taking the
  bullets under `## 17.4.0` up to the next `## ` heading.
- **No edits outside `content/docs/releases/`**, and no changeset: nothing in
  this diff is inside any package's published `files[]`.

## Gates

All 44 families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this
diff were run at `9b987e4c` and exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 44 derived / 44 run /
0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN, with an exit code recorded for each. The four the card
named that the derivation does not place — `check-docs-nav-label`,
`check:release-index-currency-sync`, `check-doc-anchors`, `check:role-word` —
were run separately and exit 0 as well.

Five of the 44 first answered PREREQUISITE-NOT-MET rather than a verdict
(`@objectstack/spec` `check:docs` and `check:skill-examples`, `@objectstack/lint`
`check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture`, and
`check:docs-transcript-drift`): they read built artifacts that a checkout does
not carry. `@objectstack/lint...` and `@objectstack/client-react...` were built
under the shared verify lock and all five then exit 0.

`pnpm docs:build` was run under the shared verify lock at `9b987e4c`:
`VERDICT command-exit 0`, "Compiled successfully", 1236/1236 static pages.

Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run. The narrowed measurement here is a real
absence rather than a skip: `eslint.config.mjs` contains zero occurrences of
`mdx`, and every `files` glob in it names only
`{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}` — so `.mdx` is outside the population eslint
judges. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the two changed paths
reports 2 file entries with 0 errors and 0 warnings. The diff adds no file of
any linted extension and does not touch `eslint.config.mjs`, so no verdict on
any untouched file can move.

## Acceptance notes

- No "machine draft", "not written", "not enumerated" or "not guessed" text
  survives on either page (grep is clean).
- `#breaking-changes--migration-in-1740`, `#upgrade-checklist` and
  `#new-in-console-studio--objectui-pins-in-1740` all resolve;
  `check-doc-anchors` exits 0.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed: the draft page's own scale line ("35
  carrying a breaking marker, 140 other minor entries, 221 patch entries") does
  not reconcile with a dedupe by commit hash, because one hash can carry several
  distinct changeset bodies across packages — `e9fcd6b` alone covers eight of
  them. It is an observation about text this PR deletes, so there is no
  successor to hand it to.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed: `content/docs/releases/index.mdx`'s v17
  entry narrates 17.0 through 17.2 and then jumps to "current series: 17.4.0",
  so a reader of the releases landing page gets no sentence about what 17.3 or
  17.4 did. Cosmetic, and outside this card's file surface. Successor: the next
  edit to that landing page.
